ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ صَلَاةً يَعُمُّ نُوْرُهَا جَمِيْعَ الْحَوَادِثِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan ya‘ummu nūruhā jamī`a ‘l-ḥawādith.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family a prayer whose light pervades all occurrences!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ مَا صَدَقَ صَادِقٌ وَنَكَثَ نَاكِثٌ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Mā ṣadaqa ṣādiqun wa nakatha nākith.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family all that the truthful confirm and the disloyal violate!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاكْفِنَا شَرَّ الْحَوَادِثِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘kfinā sharra ‘l-ḥawādith.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and protect us from unfortunate occurrences!
